topic: What if you could see everyone's bank balance?

script.text: You wake up and look out of the window. The postman is walking up the path, and there's a number floating above his head. Eight hundred and forty dollars and twelve cents. Green. He turns around. The number turns with him.

On the bus, everyone has one. The driver: three hundred and eight dollars. A woman with a gold watch and a designer bag: minus sixty-one thousand. Red. A kid your age with big headphones: nine thousand. Birthday money he has never touched.
A guy in a hoodie, eating crisps out of the bag: four point two million.
At school, Jake, who never stops talking about his dad's boat, is at eleven dollars. Mo, your best friend, is at three dollars and twelve cents. He buys a chocolate bar. Now it's one sixty-two.
Every person. Every account. To the cent. Live. And nobody else can see them. Just you. So what would actually happen if you could see everyone's bank balance?
